name: Gaymukankei: Kidnapping a Maid Has NOTHING to Do With Being GAY!!
original_name: ゲイ無関係: Kidnapping a Maid Has NOTHING to Do With Being GAY!!
source:
A sheltered rich girl, Lalaire de Falamore, finally gets to escape her neglectful mother at the age of 19. With her own house, and her own maid, Lalaire is forced to confront a side of her that she never knew existed.

Why does Lady Lalaire's thoughts get all scrambled up when she gazes at the beautiful eyes---and squishy butt---of her new transgender maid companion, Moniva Uhumani?

Had she desired a maid all these years because of mere loneliness from mommy issues, or was she simply a stupid fucking gay ass bitch?


This fluffy silly eroge is dedicated to every transbian ever who clicked on a visual novel because it had cute girls yearning on the cover only to be forced to remember they obviously gotta squeeze a dude in there between.

[From [url=https://typemaid.itch.io/kidnapping-a-maid-has-nothing-to-do-with-being-gay]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
受庇护的富家女拉莱尔·德·法拉莫尔 (Lalaire de Falamore) 在19岁时终于逃离了她疏忽大意的母亲。有了自己的房子和自己的女仆，拉莱尔被迫面对自己从未意识到的一面。

为什么当拉莱尔夫人凝视她的新变性女仆莫尼瓦·乌曼尼美丽的眼睛和柔软的屁股时，她的思绪会变得混乱？

这些年来她想要一个女仆是仅仅因为妈妈问题带来的孤独，还是她只是一个愚蠢的同性恋混蛋？


这个毛茸茸的愚蠢的工口游戏是献给每一个点击视觉小说的跨性别者的，因为它的封面上有可爱的女孩向往，却被迫记住她们显然必须在中间挤一个男人。
